## Edge or luck: Can't tell yet

_Why: A good-looking record can come from luck. If it is luck, it stops working when real money goes in._

**Next step:** Keep it on paper until about 770 more trades, then check again.

_Why: Paper trades cost nothing and add the evidence this record is missing._

### The numbers

_Read a table of closed trades: 80 closed trades, results in %._

| | |

| Trades | 80, 2025-03-03 to 2025-04-05 |

| Win rate | 59% (48% to 69%) |
| Coin-flip copies | 75 of 1,000 ended higher (passing needs odds rarer than about 1 in 1,000,000) |
| Best 3 trades | 47% of the profit; without them +0.250% per trade |
| Drop from peak | worst 22.16%, now 2.32% |
| Last 30 trades | Your last 30 trades: +3.03% in total, with a drop of 17.71% inside them. If nothing changed, a drop that deep within 30 trades happens about 1 in 9 times for this strategy. That is normal for it. |

### What would change it

- About 770 more trades at this average (+0.458% each) would settle it.
- Fresh trades the strategy was never tuned on count fully: test it on a new period and judge those trades alone (variants_tried=1).
- Costs of 0.458% per trade would wipe out the average.
- If simply holding the asset made as much over the same dates, the 'edge' may just be the market's own move.

   _Why: Backtests are usually better than live trading, so the next step depends on it._

- The range is an anytime-valid 95% range (a confidence sequence; Waudby-Smith, Arbour, Sinha, Kennedy & Ramdas 2021; Howard, Ramdas, McAuliffe & Sekhon 2021): from 30 trades on it stays valid however often you check, unlike a normal confidence interval read every day. Versions tried but not shown count as e = 0, which is valid under any dependence. One strategy alone needs e >= 40; with N versions it needs e >= 40 N, exactly where its Bonferroni-adjusted 95% range clears zero. When k of several strategies pass together, each needs e >= 40 N / k, and its range is shown at that same level (e-value ranges stay valid after e-BH picks them; Xu, Wang & Ramdas 2022). With the market's part of each trade taken out, a strategy is picked only if both its evidence before and after clear the bar.
- The spread is the sample standard deviation, widened when neighbouring trades move together: by the larger of a Newey-West long-run variance factor and a bias-corrected AR(1) factor (never narrowed).
